meta.title: Reschedule an upcoming event: move the start to tomorrow
gaps: Select tomorrow at the same time as the current start and assert that both the start and end move by exactly one day.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select tomorrow at the same time as the current start and assert that both the start and end move by exactly one day.

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ as the buyer.
Open the event's Settings menu to access Reschedule Event.
Exercise the reschedule flow and verify that the save succeeds and the round length is preserved; +3d is the closest supported start relative to now.
